package.author: Flexoptix GmbH
package.description: Desktop application for configuring FLEXOPTIX FLEXBOX transceiver modules.

en-US.author: Flexoptix GmbH
en-US.description: Desktop application for configuring FLEXOPTIX FLEXBOX transceiver modules.
en-US.longDescription: The FLEXOPTIX App is the desktop companion for FLEXBOX transceiver modules (FB-02, FB-03, FO.FB.V4 and FO.FB.5). It supports transceiver and adapter reconfiguration, transceiver details and history, Power Meter & Source, Distance Analyzer (OTDR), tuning of tunable transceivers, firmware updates, and serial number lookup.
en-US.name: FLEXOPTIX App
en-US.releaseNotes:
- Added OPM support for QSFP-DD, OSFP, and QSFP56 transceivers on Flexbox 5
- Added Mass Tuning, allowing newly inserted transceivers to be automatically tuned to a selected channel
- Added the ability to start Flexbox 5 updates manually over LTE-M / NB-IoT
- Improved app update reliability by automatically trying alternative servers when an update server can’t be reached
- Renamed Auto-Reconfiguration to Mass Reconfiguration
